title: At least one dead after landslip hits Adoormala in Idukki
description: Due to continued heavy rainfall, the Idukki District Collector has declared a holiday for all educational institutions in the district.

description: Officials identified the victim as Bhopendra from Chhattisgarh. He was shifted to a Srinagar hospital on Friday (July 31) night with chest injuries and later succumbed.

Why Neeraj Chopra's CWG 2026 silver means more with Yashvir Singh by his side
description: Neeraj Chopra secured a silver medal in the javelin throw at the Commonwealth Games.  He shared the podium with fellow Indian Yashvir Singh, who won bronze.  Yashvir achieved a personal best throw on his final attempt to claim the medal.  Chopra expressed happiness at sharing the podium with another Indian athlete.  This silver medal adds to Chopra's extensive collection of career achievements.

title: Peru ex-President Ollanta Humala walks free after conviction quashed
description: Humala, 64, was the first Peruvian ex-leader to face trial in the Odebrecht corruption scandal, which has also tainted three other former presidents — Alejandro Toledo, Martin Vizcarra and Pedro Castillo

title: 'Buy $5-10 billion yen': Bessent's note hints at US plan to back Japan's currency
description: The United States Treasury is reportedly considering buying Japanese yen. This move follows reports of potential intervention in the currency market. Japanese authorities had already intervened to support their currency earlier. The dollar slipped against the yen as these reports emerged. This marks a significant intervention in support of Japan's currency.

title: Commercial LPG prices cut by ₹209 per cylinder
description: With this revision, a 19 kg commercial cylinder will cost ₹2,872.50 in Kolkata starting from Saturday (August 1, 2026); there is no change in the prices of domestic LPG cylinders

title: 'Abusing no crime': Dipke slams FIR against Noida woman, recalls UP CM video
description: CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke questioned an FIR against a woman for abusing Prime Minister Narendra Modi. He asked why similar action was not taken against BJP leaders and IT cell members. Dipke alleged that BJP IT cell members have abused women online for years. He also cited remarks by BJP leaders and the UP Chief Minister.

title: Morning Digest: PM Modi says he wants to forgive those who abused him; migrant worker killed, another injured in terror attack in J&K’s Kulgam, and more
description: Here is a select list of stories to start the day

title: Someone should change their name to Taylor; we could be champions again: Claire Taylor
description: The 50-year-old was one of the protagonists of an era of English women’s cricket when they ‘talked world domination’ and realised the ambition. She talks with modesty and humour about her history-making career, explaining why she left a lucrative job for a sport that had little money in it, how she developed into a big-match player and whom she looked to for batting inspiration

title: Abhinandh flicks mental switch, lights up Ultimate Table Tennis
description: The 18-year-old’s fearless aggression and tactical awareness brought him success in Season 7 of the league. The performance, coming as it did as he begins the transition to the senior ranks, showed he has the technical ability and temperament to succeed at the highest level

title: Let the ink flow: Collectors and craftsmen keep fountain pens alive in Hyderabad
description: At the Hyderabad Fountain Pen Club’s monthly gatherings, collectors, hobbyists and craftsmen come together to share pens, inks and paper, exchange stories and celebrate the art of handwriting. Their passion is complemented by the work of veteran city penmakers who continue to handcraft ebonite fountain pens using time-honoured techniques, keeping alive a tradition that has endured well into the digital age

title: Celebrated at birth, pushed into sex work
description: Unlike most communities in India, the Banchhadas in M.P. invest more in their daughters’ upbringing than in their sons’, by giving them better nutrition and clothes, only so that they can force them into sex work and live off their earnings. Branded a ‘criminal tribe’ by the British and now classified as a Scheduled Caste, the community remains on society’s margins as government and NGOs have struggled to break the cycle, reports Mehul Malpani

title: Russian attacks on Kyiv kill 4, wound more than a dozen
description: More than 10 explosions were heard in a row, the journalists reported, adding that the intensity of the blasts triggered car alarms on the streets.

title: Judoka Asmita Dey breaks down recalling late father after winning CWG gold
description: Asmita Dey secured India's first judo gold medal at the Commonwealth Games. She defeated Canada's Heidi Quach in a dramatic women's 48kg final match. This victory fulfilled a dream she feared was lost after her father's death. Her father had always supported her aspirations and encouraged her to dream big. Dey credited the support from SAI Bhopal for her continued progress.

title: Commercial LPG prices cut by over Rs 200: Check 19-kg rates in Delhi, Kolkata
description: Commercial Liquefied Petroleum Gas cylinder prices have been reduced effective August 1.  A 19 kg cylinder in Kolkata saw a Rs 209 price cut.  Delhi experienced a Rs 202 reduction for the same commercial cylinder.  This marks the second consecutive month of price decreases for commercial LPG.  Domestic LPG cylinder prices remain unchanged during this period.

title: 25-35 age group records highest highway accident deaths in Karnataka over five years
description: The data showed that 10,489 people in the 25-35 age group lost their lives in National Highway accidents in Karnataka during the five-year period.

title: Wife of international kabaddi player Sheelu Balhara dies by suicide
description: Muskan Balhara, wife of international kabaddi player Sheelu Balhara, died by suicide Friday. Her family members are alleging harassment and staged a protest outside their residence. Police are investigating the incident and recording statements from family members. A forensic team has inspected the house and collected evidence for the ongoing inquiry. Muskan and Sheelu were married in December 2023 and have a young son.

title: West Asia war LIVE: White House signals Trump is weighing new strikes on Iran
description: There were no U.S. strikes on Iran overnight, but Iran’s paramilitary Revolutionary Guard said on Friday (July 31, 2026) it had struck another two tankers in the Strait of Hormuz, and Kuwait said it intercepted drones

title: Commonwealth Games: Neeraj Chopra bags silver for javelin throw, Yash Vir wins bronze
description: The 28-year-old Tokyo Olympics champion produced a season-best throw of 85.83m in his second attempt, which was good enough for a second-place finish

title: Country asking him to apologise but he has forgiven country: Congress' dig at PM over new video
description: Mr. Modi described the students as "misguided children" and said punishing them or making them go through court proceedings will not solve the problem

description: Deeply concerned over the continuing unrest and tragic loss of lives across the Line of Control, particularly in Rawalakot, says Kashmir chief cleric Mirwaiz Umar Farooq

title: Want to forgive those who abused me: Modi
description: “The children are ours, and we have to show them the right path even if it is difficult to do for people who have been misled,” says PM

title: Punjab Congress kicks off mass mobilisation programme ahead of Assembly polls
description: Congress’s general secretary in charge for Punjab, Bhupesh Bhagel said the ruling AAP was on the way out; the Congress was the only option for the State, even as he predicted a five-cornered contest in Punjab this time

title: Mayawati welcomes U.P. govt. decision to restore Sant Ravidas Nagar district name, hits out at Samajwadi Party
description: Government has re-established Sant Ravidas Nagar district, which was created by the BSP government by giving headquarters status to Bhadohi and which was changed by the Samajwadi Party government due to its narrow casteist mindset, for which the party is grateful to the State government, says Mayawati

title: How Yashvir Singh's self-talk inspired a historic javelin bronze at CWG
description: Yashvir Singh secured a historic bronze medal with a personal best throw. Neeraj Chopra won the silver medal with his season's best performance. Sri Lanka's Rumesh Tharanga Pathirage claimed the gold medal in the event. Sharing the podium with Yashvir made the achievement more special for Chopra. Both athletes achieved significant milestones during the competition.

title: White House signals Trump is weighing new strikes on Iran
description: “We'll be hitting them very hard,” Mr. Trump said in an exchange with reporters during a meeting with members of his Cabinet at the Camp David presidential retreat in Maryland

title: Infantino abandons plans to sell World Cup profits to private equity following massive pushback
description: Gianni Infantino's decision came after his senior adviser who sat on a White House panel resigned and Asia's soccer body joined Europe and North America in opposing it

title: Trump threatens to hit Iran 'very hard' as US weighs fresh attack
description: President Trump threatened very hard hits on Iran, potentially targeting energy infrastructure. Reports suggest fresh strikes could begin as early as this weekend. The United States and Israel are discussing coordinated attacks on oil refineries and power plants. This operation would mark Israel's direct involvement in a new phase of strikes. White House aides reportedly raised strong objections to the proposed military campaign.

title: Commonwealth Games: Tejaswin clinches historic bronze in decathlon
description: The Indian all-rounder dug deep to produce personal-best performances in three disciplines—long jump, discus throw and javelin throw—overcoming both physical and mental challenges to clinch a historic bronze medal

title: 'Jana Nayagan' box office collection: Thalapathy Vijay film drops 12.3%
description: Thalapathy Vijay's Jana Nayagan saw collections drop in its second week. The film earned an estimated 3.55 crore net on its ninth day. Overseas markets contributed 2 crore gross on the same day. Meanwhile, protests in Karnataka led to cancelled screenings at one theatre. The Tamil version continues to be the film's primary revenue generator.

title: Delayed aid, prolonged ordeal
description: For tuberculosis (TB) patients from economically backward regions, financial assistance through government initiatives is as crucial as medication. Delays in disbursing aid are affecting the recovery of patients from across Andhra Pradesh as they struggle to afford nutritious food and travel for treatment, writes Nellore Sravani

title: Cybercriminals widen net as assessees rush to meet I-T return filing deadline
description: Cybercriminals are targeting taxpayers during income tax return filing season. They send fake notices via WhatsApp and use cloned tax portals. These scams aim to steal banking credentials and gain device access. Attackers use malware-laden attachments and phishing websites to deceive victims. This campaign exploits the expectation of official communications from the tax department.

title: Varsha Ashok Aglawe becomes first woman GSI Director General in 176-year history
Zepto to delay IPO by 2-3 quarters, CEO tells staff
description: Zepto will delay its public listing by two to three quarters.  The quick commerce startup faced tepid investor response on its valuation.  Domestic investors offered valuations significantly lower than its last funding round.  The company now seeks Rs 1,000 crore in pre-IPO funding.  Zepto aims for a lower valuation of around $4-4.5 billion for this investment.

title: CWG 2026: India’s finest day in Glasgow yet! Six medals, 10 boxing finalists
description: India produced its biggest day of the 2026 Commonwealth Games, winning six medals to take its tally to 23. Historic judo golds for Asmita Dey and Harsh Singh, athletics medals from Tejaswin Shankar, Neeraj Chopra and Yash Vir Singh, plus a perfect 10-for-10 boxing run into finals highlighted a memorable Day 9 in Glasgow.

title: Gold loans jump 94% y-o-y, fuel bank credit growth in Q1
description: Gold loans fueled a significant acceleration in bank credit during Q1FY27. This segment expanded by 93.8% year on year, adding substantial value. Overall bank credit also saw robust growth, crossing a significant milestone. Credit to industry recorded its highest first-quarter expansion in recent years. Vehicle loans and medium enterprises also showed strong performance.

title: CWG Day 9 medal tally: Where is India now after delivering historic six-medal haul?
description: India enjoyed their best day of the 2026 Commonwealth Games, winning six medals to take their tally to 23. Harsh Singh and Asmita Dey claimed historic judo golds, Neeraj Chopra secured javelin silver, Yash Vir Singh won bronze, Tejaswin Shankar earned India's first decathlon medal, and Yamini Mourya added judo silver as India closed on ninth-placed Wales.

title: Monsoon likely to be ‘below normal’ in Aug-Sept: IMD
description: India's monsoon rainfall is expected to be below normal during August and September. This forecast is influenced by the continuing risk of El Niño, which often weakens the monsoon. July rainfall, however, turned out to be normal due to plentiful showers in central India. These showers helped reduce the overall monsoon rainfall deficit significantly by the end of July.

title: 16.4% deleted in Haryana draft roll; 10.8% in Andhra Pradesh
description: Draft voter rolls in Haryana and Andhra Pradesh reveal significant exclusions.  Over sixteen percent of Haryana's electorate and over ten percent in Andhra were removed.  Reasons cited include deaths, permanent shifts, and multiple registrations.  However, genuine voters can still be added during the claims period.  This process allows for corrections and additions to the electoral rolls.

title: The quiet appeal of snail mail
description: As AI slop fills timelines, young Indians are rediscovering analogue experiences — the realness of a handwritten letter, of a hand-drawn postcard. The irony: they find it first on social media

title: PM Modi: I forgive those who abused me & my mother, our job to guide them
description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi will forgive young protesters accused of abuse. He stated these misguided children need guidance and correction, not punishment. The Prime Minister believes punishing them will not change circumstances effectively. Mistakes made at a young age present an opportunity for correction and societal acceptance. This decision indicates that cases against these youngsters will likely be withdrawn.

title: Tahir Hussain gets life for IB staffer’s killing in 2020 riots
description: A Delhi court sentenced former AAP councillor Tahir Hussain and four others to life imprisonment.  They were convicted for the murder of Intelligence Bureau staffer Ankit Sharma.  The court found Sharma was lynched solely on account of his religion during the 2020 riots.  While the prosecution sought the death penalty, it was declined by the judge.  The judge considered educational backgrounds as a mitigating factor for the convicts.

title: What is behind the communal clashes in Nepal?
description: A local dispute over religious celebrations has spiralled into wider unrest in Nepal’s southern plains, exposing growing polarisation, delayed government response and fears over the erosion of long-standing community ties; analysts warn the row reflects mounting challenges to Nepal’s tradition of coexistence

title: ‘Dhurandhar’ gangster’s brother shot in Karachi
description: Zubair Baloch, brother of jailed gangster Uzair Baloch, was critically wounded in a drive-by shooting. Two masked assailants on a motorcycle opened fire, striking him in the chest and abdomen. Zubair was rushed to Civil Hospital Karachi for emergency surgery after the attack. Police are investigating personal enmity and potential gang war resurgence as motives. The incident occurred in Karachi's Lyari neighborhood, a historic hub of organized crime.

title: Amid opposition protest, Lok Sabha passes births & deaths bill
description: The Lok Sabha passed the Registration of Births and Deaths (Amendment) Bill, 2026, without any debate. Opposition members disrupted Rajya Sabha proceedings, preventing any business from being transacted. The bill aims to make delayed registrations of births and deaths more stringent. Congress and SP MPs raised issues concerning police actions and alleged temple donation theft. The Rajya Sabha was ultimately adjourned for the entire day.

title: India flags POJK at world stage
Brittany Mahomes breaks silence on women eyeing Chiefs star Patrick Mahomes
description: Patrick Mahomes and his wife Brittany Mahomes have been together for close to two decades now but it seems the attention has also sparked women pursuing the star player. The popular entrepreneur brittany Mahomes has now opened up about women pursuing her husband.

title: Ethanol kept petrol prices lower: Govt
description: Ethanol blending saved consumers nearly thirty rupees per litre on petrol.  Global crude prices reached one hundred thirty-five dollars a barrel recently.  The government kept fuel prices unchanged for seventy-five days initially.  E20 petrol now costs one hundred two rupees per litre in Delhi.  Allegations of foodgrain diversion for ethanol were also rejected.

title: Nuclear plants, Gaza craters: Google pulls AI tool from Google Earth in 24 hours
description: Google has removed its new AI image generation feature from Google Earth. This action followed immediate concerns raised by researchers about disinformation risks. Experts warned the tool could easily create convincing fake satellite imagery for public deception. Google stated they are implementing stronger safeguards while pausing the feature. The company noted generated images were watermarked as AI-created.

title: Triumph of justice vs Hussain a BJP man: parties trade barbs after Tahir Hussain verdict
description: While the BJP hailed the court order for “establishing how AAP-backed miscreants spread riots in north-east Delhi”, the Opposition party hit back, claiming that Hussain was “indirectly working for the BJP”.

description: Activists alleged that the supply of contaminated water was creating a situation in the area similar to Indore’s Bhagirathpura, where government-supplied sewage-contaminated water claimed more than 35 lives

title: SC slaps Rs 1 lakh fine on Rajasthan government for harassing official
description: The Supreme Court has ordered Rajasthan to pay one lakh rupees to a government official. This payment is compensation for harassment caused by political interference in a prosecution sanction. The court criticized the joint secretary of the former chief minister for undue influence. Such interference was deemed a blatant display of political dictate by the state. The official was unnecessarily dragged to court, prompting the court's strong observations.

title: Supreme Court moots protocol to access court’s livestream archives
description: Move is intended to prevent commercial exploitation and misuse of judicial hearings; a July 24 interim order had barred the circulation of livestream proceedings on digital platforms, reversing principle of open justice, activists said

Lowa couple skipped $2.2M HGTV home in 2008. It's now listed for $11.5M
description: Nearly two decades after it was awarded as the grand prize in HGTV's popular Dream Home sweepstakes, the iconic 2008 HGTV Dream Home in the Florida Keys has returned to the market, this time with a $14.9 million price tag. It was won by Iowa couple Stephanie and Tommy Dee, who chose to take the cash equivalent of the prize instead of moving into the property.

title: How family tragedy shaped Lamine Yamal's remarkable journey to football stardom
description: Lamine Yamal's rise to winning the 2026 FIFA World Cup is inseparable from the story of the family that built him. His mother Sheila Ebana was 16 when she gave birth to him. His father Mounir, a Moroccan immigrant, worked construction and street jobs to stay afloat. His grandmother Fátima crossed from Morocco to Spain alone, undocumented, and worked three jobs to bring her children over. His father survived a life-threatening stabbing in August 2024. Yamal's name itself honours two strangers who helped his parents financially before he was born. This is the full human story behind the boy who hugged his little brother on a World Cup pitch in New Jersey.

'Project Kusha will cut India’s dependence on imported air shield systems'
description: India successfully tested its indigenous Project Kusha missile system recently. This development aims to create a homegrown long-range air defence capability. The system will counter aerial threats from China and Pakistan effectively. Project Kusha is designed to intercept various aerial targets up to 400 kilometers. Full military induction and deployment are expected between 2028 and 2030.

description: “The atmosphere is not right at this point of time,” Mr. Shivakumar said, addressing a press meet.

title: When a district in Florida's Everglades used robot rabbits to eliminate Burmese pythons
description: Florida is employing AI-powered robot rabbits to help locate invasive Burmese pythons. These solar-powered decoys mimic prey using heat and scent to lure snakes. When a python is detected, officials are alerted to remove the invasive species. This technology complements the annual Python Challenge, which has removed thousands of snakes. These efforts aim to control the python population impacting native wildlife.

title: Chairman of company tried to get MD killed to avoid repaying Rs 32 crore, arrested
description: Waliv police arrested seven individuals, including the alleged mastermind, in an attempted murder case. The chairman of GSM Foils plotted to kill the managing director to evade repaying thirty-two crore rupees. He suffered significant financial losses after the US stock market crashed following the Iran-Israel conflict. The attack occurred at the company's premises, and the victim sustained a gunshot wound.

title: Hockey jersey row: Dilip Tirkey questions process, his federation cites precedent
description: Hockey India president Dilip Tirkey questioned the jersey colour change process.  He stated the decision lacked executive board discussion and his prior knowledge.  Executive director RK Srivastava defended the saffron kit based on technical and performance factors.  Other board members also raised concerns about transparency and accountability.  This controversy emerges amid ongoing governance scrutiny for Hockey India.

title: Chhattisgarh worker shot dead, another wounded in first J&K terror attack on migrants in 21 months
description: Terrorists shot dead a 24-year-old labourer from Chhattisgarh in Kulgam. Another worker from the same state was critically wounded in the attack. Security forces have launched operations to trace the attackers responsible for this incident. This incident marks the first fatal attack on migrant workers since October 18. Officials condemned the attack and directed security forces to intensify operations.

title: Cut with saws, hit with cars: why Americans are destroying 120,000 Flock cameras
description: Americans are vandalizing Flock Safety cameras nationwide amid privacy worries. Several US cities have deactivated these cameras or canceled contracts. Critics argue the network infringes on personal liberties and privacy rights. Reports of misuse and accuracy questions have intensified the ongoing debate. This opposition unites individuals across different political viewpoints.

title: 'I felt that everything was over': Asmita remembers late father after historic judo gold
description: Asmita Dey secured India's first judo gold medal at the Commonwealth Games. She defeated Canada's Heidi Quach in a gripping golden score final match. This historic victory came after overcoming personal tragedy and immense dedication. Harsh Singh also won a gold medal in the men's 60kg judo event. These twin triumphs marked a significant breakthrough for Indian judo.

title: 'Not agreed to that': Trump shifts stance on Ukraine building Patriot missiles
CWG: India strike double gold in judo as Asmita Dey, Harsh Singh make history
description: Asmita created history by becoming the first Indian judoka to win a Commonwealth Games gold medal after defeating Canada's Heidi Quach in the women's 48kg final.

Michigan woman sues Toll Brothers over land access and wastewater plan
description: A woman from Michigan has initiated legal action against Toll Brothers concerning their wastewater management and access rights. Her property, undeveloped, is situated between two upcoming luxury housing estates. The lawsuit alleges that the developers have disregarded her property rights and neglected environmental regulations. She aims to reinstate her access easement and challenge the site plan approvals.

title: 'Pak-trained Mujahideen turned guns inwards': MEA slams Islamabad over PoK crackdown
description: India condemned Pakistan's admission of training and arming militants who have turned against the state. The Ministry of External Affairs also criticized Pakistan's harsh crackdown on protesters in Pakistan-occupied Jammu and Kashmir. Over forty civilians were reportedly killed during the violent suppression of peaceful demonstrations. India stated that Pakistan's actions exposed its disdain for the region's innocent inhabitants.

title: Jharkhand zoo hatches cobra and sand boa eggs through artificial incubation first time
description: The Bhagwan Birsa Biological Park successfully incubated Spectacled Cobra eggs artificially. Five healthy hatchlings emerged after a seventy-day incubation period under controlled conditions. The park also welcomed eight Sand Boa hatchlings during this conservation initiative. This success highlights the importance of scientific management in reptile breeding programs. The hatchlings are now under close observation and veterinary care.

title: Happy girlfriend day: Top 75 wishes, messages, greetings and quotes
description: Girlfriend Day offers a chance to express appreciation for loved ones.  Simple messages can convey deep feelings and strengthen relationships.  Personalizing sentiments makes them more meaningful and memorable for your girlfriend.  The article provides numerous examples for various relationship dynamics.  Ultimately, genuine connection is the most important gift you can give.
